name: WeAct BluePill Plus CH32V203
description: RISC-V Blue Pill replacement: CH32V203C8T6 (144 MHz QingKe V4B, 64 KB flash, 20 KB RAM, USB FS) on a USB-C 2x20 board for about $4; very cheap fast RISC-V with USB.
notes: Same 52.81 x 20.78 mm board as the Black Pill but with the classic Blue Pill pin order (NRST/PB11/PB10 near the 3V3 pin). Header positions assume the Black Pill geometry (rows 15.2 mm apart).
User KEY on PA0, blue LED on PB2 (active high); 4-pin SWD header. Program with a WCH-LinkE (SWD/SDI) or WCHISPTool; unpopulated SPI flash footprint (U3).
Also sold with CH32F103, CH32V103 and CH32V303 chips on the same PCB. Toolchain support: MounRiver Studio, Arduino core (ch32-community), PlatformIO.
